channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — Latest Movers
channel.description: Actively exploited vulnerabilities rising fastest in Cyber Threat Wall rankings.

item.title: CVE-2026-41709 — Broadcom VMware ESX
item.description: Threat Signal 52. Broadcom VMWare ESX contains an insufficient logging vulnerability that could allow a malicious actor with admin access to perform certain operations without being logged.

item.title: CVE-2026-96655 — Plex Media Server
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Plex Media Server contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability that could allow an authenticated user to request arbitrary internal or external addresses via the '/video/:/transcode/universal' path parameter. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96654, and CVE-2026-96656.

item.title: CVE-2026-96652 — Plex Media Server
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Plex Media Server contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability which could allow an attacker using any X-Plex-Token value to include a full URL in the 'protocol' parameter and force the Plex server to POST to the attacker's chosen destination. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96654, CVE-2026-96655, and CVE-2026-96656.

item.title: CVE-2025-61624 — Fortinet Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 60. FortiOS, FortiPAM, FortiProxy, and FortiSwitchManager contain a path traversal vulnerability that may allow an authenticated attacker with admin profile and at least read-write permissions to write or delete arbitrary files via specific CLI commands.

item.title: CVE-2026-87886 — Acronis Backup
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Acronis Backup plugin for cPanel & WHM and extension for Plesk contains an incorrect default permissions vulnerability that could allow for privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2026-81963 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Microsoft Windows Update Stack contains a link following vulnerability that allows a local attacker to escalate privileges locally up to SYSTEM.

item.title: CVE-2026-85880 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Microsoft Windows Advanced Local Procedure Call contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows an attacker to elevate privileges locally.

item.title: CVE-2026-53362 — Linux Kernel
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Linux Kernel contains an unspecified vulnerability that can allow for privilege escalation via IPv6 networking subsystem. This vulnerability can impact multiple products, including but not limited to Suse, Red Hat, and other products using Linux.

item.title: CVE-2026-18556 — N-able N-central
item.description: Threat Signal 60. N-able N-central contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel that allows for authentication bypass.

item.title: CVE-2025-68686 — Fortinet FortiOS
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Fortinet FortiOS contains an exposure of sensitive information to an unauthorized actor vulnerability. This may allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to bypass the patch developed for the symbolic link persistency mechanism observed in some post-exploit cases, via crafted HTTP requests. An attacker would need first to have compromised the product via another vulnerability, at filesystem level.

item.title: CVE-2026-11645 — Google Chromium V8
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Google Chromium V8 out-of-bounds read and write vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside a sandbox via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2026-41091 — Microsoft Defender
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Microsoft Defender contains a link following vulnerability that allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.

item.title: CVE-2023-36424 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Microsoft Windows Common Log File System Driver contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability that could allow a threat actor for privileges escalation

item.title: CVE-2026-34621 — Adobe Acrobat and Reader
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Adobe Acrobat and Reader contain a prototype pollution vulnerability that allows for arbitrary code execution.

item.title: CVE-2025-31277 — Apple Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Apple Safari, iOS, watchOS, visionOS, iPadOS, macOS, and tvOS contain a buffer overflow vulnerability that could allow the processing of maliciously crafted web content which may lead to memory corruption.

item.title: CVE-2026-3909 — Google Skia
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Google Skia contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to perform out of bounds memory access via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability affects Google Chrome and ChromeOS, Android, Flutter, and possibly other products.

item.title: CVE-2022-20775 — Cisco SD-WAN
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Cisco SD-WAN CLI contains a path traversal vulnerability that could allow an authenticated local attacker to gain elevated privileges via improper access controls on commands within the application CLI. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to execute arbitrary commands as the root user.

item.title: CVE-2026-25108 — Soliton Systems K.K FileZen
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Soliton Systems K.K FileZen contains an OS command injection vulnerability when an user logs-in to the affected product and sends a specially crafted HTTP request.

item.title: CVE-2025-61932 — Motex LANSCOPE Endpoint Manager
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Motex LANSCOPE Endpoint Manager contains an improper verification of source of a communication channel vulnerability allowing an attacker to execute arbitrary code by sending specially crafted packets.

item.title: CVE-2025-21043 — Samsung Mobile Devices
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Samsung mobile devices contain an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in libimagecodec.quram.so which allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code.

item.title: CVE-2025-8876 — N-able N-Central
item.description: Threat Signal 60. N-able N-Central contains a command injection vulnerability via improper sanitization of user input.

item.title: CVE-2025-6558 — Google Chromium
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Google Chromium contains an improper input validation vulnerability in ANGLE and GPU. This vulnerability could allow a remote attacker to potentially perform a sandbox escape via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2025-6543 — Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway contain a buffer overflow vulnerability leading to unintended control flow and Denial of Service. NetScaler must be configured as Gateway (VPN virtual server, ICA Proxy, CVPN, RDP Proxy) OR AAA virtual server.

item.title: CVE-2025-5419 — Google Chromium V8
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Google Chromium V8 contains an out-of-bounds read and write vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2025-30397 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Microsoft Windows Scripting Engine contains a type confusion vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network via a specially crafted URL.

item.title: CVE-2024-49035 — Microsoft Partner Center
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Microsoft Partner Center contains an improper access control vulnerability that allows an attacker to escalate privileges.

item.title: CVE-2025-24989 — Microsoft Power Pages
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Microsoft Power Pages contains an improper access control vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network potentially bypassing the user registration control.

item.title: CVE-2025-23209 — Craft CMS Craft CMS
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Craft CMS contains a code injection vulnerability caused by improper validation of the database backup path, ultimately enabling remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2024-44308 — Apple Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Apple iOS, macOS, and other Apple products contain an unspecified vulnerability when processing maliciously crafted web content that may lead to arbitrary code execution.

item.title: CVE-2024-9537 — ScienceLogic SL1
item.description: Threat Signal 60. ScienceLogic SL1 (formerly EM7) is affected by an unspecified vulnerability involving an unspecified third-party component.

item.title: CVE-2013-0648 — Adobe Flash Player
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Adobe Flash Player contains an unspecified vulnerability in the ExternalInterface ActionScript functionality that allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via crafted SWF content.

item.title: CVE-2013-0643 — Adobe Flash Player
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Adobe Flash Player contains an incorrect default permissions vulnerability in the Firefox sandbox that allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via crafted SWF content.

item.title: CVE-2024-7262 — Kingsoft WPS Office
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Kingsoft WPS Office contains a path traversal vulnerability in promecefpluginhost.exe on Windows that allows an attacker to load an arbitrary Windows library.

item.title: CVE-2024-38189 — Microsoft Project
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Microsoft Project contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution via a malicious file.

item.title: CVE-2024-4761 — Google Chromium V8
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Google Chromium V8 Engine contains an unspecified out-of-bounds memory write vulnerability via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2024-23222 — Apple Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, tvOS, and Safari WebKit contain a type confusion vulnerability that leads to code execution when processing maliciously crafted web content. This vulnerability could impact HTML parsers that use WebKit, including but not limited to Apple Safari and non-Apple products which rely on WebKit for HTML processing.

item.title: CVE-2023-7101 — Spreadsheet::ParseExcel Spreadsheet::ParseExcel
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Spreadsheet::ParseExcel contains a remote code execution vulnerability due to passing unvalidated input from a file into a string-type “eval”. Specifically, the issue stems from the evaluation of Number format strings within the Excel parsing logic.

item.title: CVE-2023-6448 — Unitronics Vision PLC and HMI
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Unitronics Vision Series PLCs and HMIs ship with an insecure default password, which if left unchanged, can allow attackers to execute remote commands.

item.title: CVE-2023-42917 — Apple Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and Safari WebKit contain a memory corruption vulnerability that leads to code execution when processing maliciously crafted web content. This vulnerability could impact HTML parsers that use WebKit, including but not limited to Apple Safari and non-Apple products which rely on WebKit for HTML processing.

item.title: CVE-2023-28434 — MinIO MinIO
item.description: Threat Signal 60. MinIO contains a security feature bypass vulnerability that allows an attacker to use crafted requests to bypass metadata bucket name checking and put an object into any bucket while processing `PostPolicyBucket` to conduct privilege escalation. To carry out this attack, the attacker requires credentials with `arn:aws:s3:::*` permission, as well as enabled Console API access.

item.title: CVE-2023-32409 — Apple Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, tvOS, watchOS, and Safari WebKit contain an unspecified vulnerability that can allow a remote attacker to break out of the Web Content sandbox. This vulnerability could impact HTML parsers that use WebKit, including but not limited to Apple Safari and non-Apple products which rely on WebKit for HTML processing.

item.title: CVE-2023-32373 — Apple Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, tvOS, watchOS, and Safari WebKit contain a use-after-free vulnerability that leads to code execution when processing maliciously crafted web content. This vulnerability could impact HTML parsers that use WebKit, including but not limited to Apple Safari and non-Apple products which rely on WebKit for HTML processing.

item.title: CVE-2021-3560 — Red Hat Polkit
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Red Hat Polkit contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability through the bypassing of credential checks for D-Bus requests, allowing for privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2015-5317 — Jenkins Jenkins User Interface (UI)
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Jenkins User Interface (UI) contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows users to see the names of jobs and builds otherwise inaccessible to them on the "Fingerprints" pages.

item.title: CVE-2023-2136 — Google Chromium Skia
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Google Chromium Skia contains an integer overflow vulnerability that allows a remote attacker, who has compromised the renderer process, to potentially perform a sandbox escape via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability affects Google Chrome and ChromeOS, Android, Flutter, and possibly other products.

item.title: CVE-2023-23529 — Apple Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Apple iOS, MacOS, Safari and iPadOS WebKit contain a type confusion vulnerability that leads to code execution when processing maliciously crafted web content. This vulnerability could impact HTML parsers that use WebKit, including but not limited to Apple Safari and non-Apple products which rely on WebKit for HTML processing.

item.title: CVE-2022-42856 — Apple iOS
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Apple iOS contains a type confusion vulnerability when processing maliciously crafted web content leading to code execution.

item.title: CVE-2022-3723 — Google Chromium V8
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Google Chromium V8 Engine contains a type confusion vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. item.title: CVE-2022-3075 — Google Chromium Mojo
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Google Chromium Mojo contains an insufficient data validation vulnerability that allows a remote attacker, who has compromised the renderer process, to potentially perform a sandbox escape via a crafted HTML page. item.title: CVE-2022-32893 — Apple iOS and macOS
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Apple iOS and macOS contain an out-of-bounds write vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution when processing malicious crafted web content.
